newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila SEC approves new Zeus shares.
newsitem.headline: Manila SEC approves new Zeus shares.

text.p: The Philippines' Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has approved the registration of 1.538 billion new Zeus Holdings Inc shares to be entered into a swap deal, the company said on Friday.
The new shares, with par value of one peso each, form part of the authorised capital increase to one billion pesos from 300 million pesos.
"These shares will be issued in exchange for shares of stock of Mindanao Portland Cement Corp, real estate properties and receivables," the company said in a statement.
Zeus used to be a garment company before it was converted into a holding company.
